# Read in Data
```{r global options,  warning=FALSE}
# install.packages("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/emmeans/emmeans_1.4.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type = "source")
library(psych)
library(readr)
library(sjPlot)
library(emmeans)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)

d <- read_rds("~/Box Sync/Lifting the Bar Materials & Data/LTB Data/LTB School Data/Cleaned Data/Juvenile_Recidivism.rds")
sessionInfo()
```

```{r include=FALSE}
ltb <-
  read_rds("~/Box Sync/Lifting the Bar Materials & Data/LTB Data/LTB Intervention Data/Fall '16-Spring '17 & Fall '17-Spring '18 Intervention Data (Filtered & cleaned).rds")

d <- 
  ltb %>% 
  dplyr::select(id, s0.demo_edu_mom) %>% 
  left_join(d, ltb, by = "id")

d <-
  d %>% 
  mutate(gender_nonmale = ifelse(gender == "Other" | gender == "F", 1, 0))

describe(d$s0.demo_edu_mom)
d <-
  d %>% 
  mutate(imputed_mothers_ed = ifelse(is.na(s0.demo_edu_mom), 2.30, s0.demo_edu_mom))

# add days in custody variable
str(d$booked)
str(d$released)
d <-
  d %>% 
  mutate(days_in_custody = as.numeric((released - booked) + 1))

d %>% 
  dplyr::select(booked, released, days_in_custody)
str(d$days_in_custody)
```

# Model 1
```{r warning=FALSE}
options("scipen" = 100, "digits" = 4)

model1 <- 
  glm(juvenile_recidivism_USETHIS ~ cond_f,
      data = d, family = binomial, na.action = na.omit)

tab_model(model1, show.stat = T, string.stat = "z-value", dv.labels = "Model 1", 
          string.p = "P-Value", transform = NULL)

summary(model1)

# Odds Ratios, zs, and ps between all conditions
emmean <- emmeans(model1, "cond_f", type = "response")
pairs <- pairs(emmean, reverse = TRUE, adjust = "none")
kable_styling(kable(pairs))

# how many participants per condition?
table(model1$model$cond_f)

```

## 1b - incl months after release
```{r}
model1b <- 
  glm(juvenile_recidivism_USETHIS ~ cond_f + months_after_jjc,
      data = d, family = binomial, na.action = na.omit)

tab_model(model1b, show.stat = T, string.stat = "z-value", dv.labels = "Model 1b", 
          string.p = "P-Value", transform = NULL)

summary(model1b)

# Odds Ratios, zs, and ps between all conditions, and conversion of coefficient to probability estimate
emmean <- emmeans(model1b, "cond_f", type = "response")
emmean
pairs <- pairs(emmean, reverse = TRUE, adjust = "none")
pairs

```

# Model 2
## Model 2A
```{r warning=FALSE}
model2a <- glm(juvenile_recidivism_USETHIS ~ cond_f +
                 months_after_jjc +

                 gender_nonmale +
                 age_intv + s0.demo_edu_mom,
               data = d, family = binomial, na.action = na.omit)

tab_model(model2a, show.stat = T, string.stat = "z-value", dv.labels = "Model 2a", 
          string.p = "P-Value", transform = NULL)

summary(model2a)

# Odds Ratios, zs, and ps between all conditions
emmean <- emmeans(model2a, "cond_f", type = "response")
pairs <- pairs(emmean, reverse = TRUE, adjust = "none")
kable_styling(kable(pairs))

# participants per condition
table(model2a$model$cond_f) 
```

# Correlate Recidivism and Evaluation time
The effect this time differential may have on the results is dependent on the variation of time from intervention to recidivism evaluation. Was there a significant difference in recidivism based on time of release?

Test the correlations between (1) time since release, (2) days in custody, and (3) recidivism.
```{r}
recidivism <-
  d %>% 
  dplyr::select(id, juvenile_recidivism_USETHIS, months_after_jjc, days_in_custody) 

recidivism_cor <-
  recidivism %>% 
  dplyr::select(-id) %>% 
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

## pearson's r
kable_styling(kable(recidivism_cor))

recidivism_cor_p.mat <- ggcorrplot::cor_pmat(recidivism_cor)

## p-values on correlation
kable_styling(kable(recidivism_cor_p.mat))

```
